method: We compared the 10 zero-ozone ENERGY STAR air purifiers with the highest certified smoke CADR per watt, weighing efficiency, smoke CADR and the five-year electricity cost (certified yearly energy use x current EIA U.S. average residential price x 5).
name: The most energy-efficient air purifiers, ranked by certified CADR per watt
scoring: each value scored against the best on the page (best = 1), times its weight; total out of 100
